430: 	}

432: 		record.Consumed = true
433: 		return app.Confirmation{}, errStaleConfirmation
434: 	}
435: 	record.Consumed = true

type projectRoadmapPreview struct {
	Completed int
	Total     int

	Next      *app.WebRoadmapSprint
}

func makeProjectRoadmapPreview(project app.WebProjectResult) *projectRoadmapPreview {
	preview := &projectRoadmapPreview{}
	var nextPlanned *app.WebRoadmapSprint
	for _, phase := range project.Roadmap {
		for _, sprint := range phase.Sprints {
			preview.Total++
			if sprint.Status == "delivered" {
				preview.Completed++
				if preview.Previous == nil || sprint.Number > preview.Previous.Number {
					copy := sprint
					preview.Previous = &copy
				}
				continue
			}
			if sprint.Status == "active" && (preview.Next == nil || preview.Next.Status != "active" || sprint.Number < preview.Next.Number) {
				copy := sprint
				preview.Next = &copy
				continue
			}
			if nextPlanned == nil || sprint.Number < nextPlanned.Number {
				copy := sprint
				nextPlanned = &copy
			}
		}
	}
	if preview.Next == nil {
		preview.Next = nextPlanned
	}
	return preview
}

		return
	}
	for _, value := range match.params {
		valid := validIdentifier(value)
		if strings.Contains(match.name, "artifact") {
			valid = validOpaqueRef(value)
		}
		if !valid {
			h.writeRouteError(w, r, match.api, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "The resource identifier is invalid.")
			return
		}
	}

	switch match.name {
	case "dashboard":
		result, err := h.queries.Dashboard(r.Context())
		if err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, false, err)
			return
		}
		h.render(w, r, http.StatusOK, "dashboard", pageModel{Title: "Workspace dashboard", Heading: "Workspace dashboard", Workspace: result.Workspace, Projects: result.Projects.Items, Sprints: result.Sprints, Studies: result.Studies.Items})

			return
		}
		h.render(w, r, http.StatusOK, "project", pageModel{Title: "Project " + result.Name, Heading: result.Name, Project: &result, RoadmapPreview: makeProjectRoadmapPreview(result), Page: "overview"})

			return
		}
		h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{
			"workspace": result.Workspace,
			"ref":       result.Ref,
			"projects":  mapProjects(result.Projects.Items, false),
			"sprints":   mapSprints(result.Sprints),
			"studies":   mapStudies(result.Studies.Items),
			"counts": map[string]any{
				"projects": mapCollection(result.Projects.CollectionInfo),
				"sprints":  mapCollection(result.SprintCounts),
				"studies":  mapCollection(result.Studies.CollectionInfo),
			},
		}, nil)
	case "api_projects":
		result, err := h.queries.Projects(r.Context())
		if err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
			return
		}
		h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, mapProjects(result.Items, false), &result.CollectionInfo)
	case "api_project":
		result, err := h.queries.Project(r.Context(), match.params[0])
		if err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
			return
		}
		h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, mapProject(result, true), &result.SprintCounts)
	case "api_sprint":
		result, err := h.queries.Sprint(r.Context(), match.params[0], match.params[1])
		if err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
			return
		}
		h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, mapSprint(result), nil)
	case "api_sprint_qa":
		h.handleSprintQA(w, r, match.params[0], match.params[1])
	case "api_sprint_qa_map":
		h.handleSprintQAMap(w, r, match.params[0], match.params[1])
	case "api_sprint_qa_shard":
		h.handleSprintQAShard(w, r, match.params[0], match.params[1], match.params[2])
	case "api_sprint_qa_theory":
		h.handleSprintQATheory(w, r, match.params[0], match.params[1], match.params[2])
	case "api_sprint_qa_synthesis":
		h.handleSprintQASynthesis(w, r, match.params[0], match.params[1])
	case "api_models":
		queries, ok := h.queries.(app.WebModelQueries)
		if !ok {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, app.ErrWebUnavailable)
			return
		}
		result, err := queries.Models(r.Context())
		if err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
			return
		}
		models := make([]map[string]any, 0, len(result.Models))
		for _, model := range result.Models {
			models = append(models, map[string]any{"provider": model.Provider, "id": model.ID, "reference": strings.TrimPrefix(model.Provider+"/"+model.ID, "/")})
		}
		h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"models": models, "default": result.Default}, nil)
	case "api_prompt_bundle":
		queries, ok := h.queries.(app.WebPromptQueries)
		if !ok {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, app.ErrWebUnavailable)
			return
		}
		result, err := queries.PromptBundle(r.Context(), match.params[0], match.params[1], match.params[2])
		if err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
			return
		}
		h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, mapPromptBundle(result), nil)
	case "api_studies":
		result, err := h.queries.Studies(r.Context())
		if err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
			return
		}
		h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, mapStudies(result.Items), &result.CollectionInfo)
	case "api_study":
		result, err := h.queries.Study(r.Context(), match.params[0])
		if err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
			return
		}
		h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, mapStudy(result), nil)
	case "api_study_resources":
		queries, ok := h.queries.(app.WebResourceQueries)
		if !ok {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, app.ErrWebUnavailable)
			return
		}
		result, err := queries.StudyResources(r.Context(), match.params[0])
		if err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
			return
		}
		h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, result, nil)
	case "api_validations":
		h.handleValidations(w, r)
	case "api_artifact":
		result, err := h.queries.Artifact(r.Context(), match.params[0])
		if err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
			return
		}
		if err := validateArtifact(result); err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
			return
		}
		h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, mapArtifactPreview(result), nil)
	case "api_health":
		result, err := h.queries.Health(r.Context())
		if err != nil {
			h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
			return
		}
		status := http.StatusOK
		if result.Status != "ok" || !result.Workspace {
			status = http.StatusServiceUnavailable
		}
		data := map[string]any{"status": result.Status, "server": result.Server, "workspace": result.Workspace}
		if h.runs != nil {
			if runHealth, runErr := h.runs.RunHealth(r.Context()); runErr == nil {
				data["run_control"] = runHealth
			} else {
				data["run_control"] = map[string]any{"status": "failed"}
				status = http.StatusServiceUnavailable
			}
		}
		h.writeSuccess(w, r, status, data, nil)
	case "api_runs":
		h.handleRuns(w, r)
	case "api_timeline":
		h.handleTimeline(w, r)
	case "api_run":
		if r.Method == http.MethodDelete {
			h.handleRunCancel(w, r, match.params[0])
		} else {
			h.handleRunShow(w, r, match.params[0])
		}
	case "api_run_events":
		h.handleRunEvents(w, r, match.params[0])
	case "api_operation_prepare":
		h.handleOperationPrepare(w, r)
	case "api_operations":
		if r.Method == http.MethodPost {
			h.handleOperationStart(w, r)
		} else {
			h.handleActiveOperations(w, r)
		}
	case "api_operation":
		if r.Method == http.MethodDelete {
			h.handleOperationCancel(w, r, match.params[0])
		} else {
			h.handleOperationStatus(w, r, match.params[0])
		}
	case "api_operation_events":
		h.handleOperationEvents(w, r, match.params[0])
	case "operation_prepare":
		h.handleHTMLOperationPrepare(w, r)
	case "sprint_create":
		h.handleSprintCreate(w, r, match.params[0])
	case "operation_start":
		h.handleHTMLOperationStart(w, r)
	case "operation_cancel":
		h.handleHTMLOperationCancel(w, r, match.params[0])
	case "operation":
		h.handleHTMLOperationStatus(w, r, match.params[0])
	default:
		h.writeRouteError(w, r, match.api, http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "The requested resource was not found.")
	}
}

func (h *handler) loadRepoBoard(r *http.Request, name string, model *pageModel) error {
	queries, ok := h.queries.(app.WebStudyReportQueries)
	if !ok {
		return app.ErrWebUnavailable
	}
	result, err := queries.StudyRepos(r.Context(), name)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	byName := make(map[string]app.WebRepoScore, len(result.Repos))
	for _, repo := range result.Repos {
		byName[repo.Name] = repo
	}
	labels := make(map[string]string)
	columns := make([]string, 0)
	for _, repo := range result.Repos {
		for _, entry := range repo.Scores {
			if _, seen := labels[entry.Number]; !seen {
				labels[entry.Number] = entry.Dimension
				columns = append(columns, entry.Number)
			}
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(columns)
	topScores := make(map[string]int, len(columns))
	for _, number := range columns {
		best := 0
		for _, repo := range result.Repos {
			for _, score := range repo.Scores {
				if score.Number == number && score.Score > best {
					best = score.Score
				}
			}
		}
		topScores[number] = best
	}
	for _, number := range columns {
		model.RepoColumns = append(model.RepoColumns, repoMatrixColumn{Number: number, Label: labels[number]})
	}
	for index, repo := range result.Repos {
		entry := repoBoardEntry{
			Rank:     index + 1,
			Name:     repo.Name,
			Coverage: fmt.Sprintf("%d / %d dimensions rated", repo.RatedCount, repo.Applicable),
		}
		if repo.RatedCount > 0 {
			entry.Average = strconv.FormatFloat(repo.Average, 'f', 1, 64)
			entry.BarWidth = int(math.Round(repo.Average * 10))
		} else {
			entry.Average = "-"
		}
		if repo.Best != nil {
			entry.BestRef = repo.Best.Ref
			entry.BestText = repo.Best.Dimension + " · " + strconv.Itoa(repo.Best.Score)
		}
		model.RepoBoard = append(model.RepoBoard, entry)

		scoreByName := byName[repo.Name]
		applicable := make(map[string]bool, len(scoreByName.ApplicableNumbers))
		for _, number := range scoreByName.ApplicableNumbers {
			applicable[number] = true
		}
		row := repoMatrixRow{Name: repo.Name, Average: entry.Average}
		for _, column := range columns {
			cell := repoMatrixCell{Label: "n/a"}
			if applicable[column] {
				cell = repoMatrixCell{Label: "–"}
			}
			for _, score := range scoreByName.Scores {
				if score.Number == column {
					cell = repoMatrixCell{Label: strconv.Itoa(score.Score), Scored: true, Percent: score.Score * 10, Leader: topScores[column] > 0 && score.Score == topScores[column], Ref: score.Ref}
					break
				}
			}
			row.Cells = append(row.Cells, cell)
		}
		model.RepoMatrix = append(model.RepoMatrix, row)
	}
	for _, dimension := range result.Dimensions {
		champion := repoChampion{Dimension: dimension.Dimension}
		for _, leader := range dimension.Leaders {
			champion.Leaders = append(champion.Leaders, repoLeaderView{Rank: leader.Rank, Name: leader.Name, Score: leader.Score, Ref: leader.Ref})
		}
		model.RepoChampions = append(model.RepoChampions, champion)
	}
	return nil
}

func (h *handler) studyReportViews(r *http.Request, name string) ([]reportLinkView, []reportGroupView, error) {
	queries, ok := h.queries.(app.WebStudyReportQueries)
	if !ok {
		return nil, nil, app.ErrWebUnavailable
	}
	result, err := queries.StudyReports(r.Context(), name)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	var finals []reportLinkView
	var groups []reportGroupView
	for _, dimension := range result.Dimensions {
		ref := dimension.Number
		if dimension.Slug != "" {
			ref += "-" + dimension.Slug
		}
		if dimension.Final != nil {
			finals = append(finals, reportLinkView{Label: ref, Ref: dimension.Final.Ref, DisplayPath: dimension.Final.DisplayPath, Bytes: dimension.Final.Bytes})
		}
		if len(dimension.Sources) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		group := reportGroupView{Dimension: ref, Reports: make([]reportLinkView, 0, len(dimension.Sources))}
		for _, source := range dimension.Sources {
			group.Reports = append(group.Reports, reportLinkView{Label: source.Source, Ref: source.Ref, DisplayPath: source.DisplayPath, Bytes: source.Bytes})
		}
		groups = append(groups, group)
	}
	return nonNilSlice(finals), nonNilSlice(groups), nil
}

// loadSprintFlowUsage fetches the per-stage sprint runtime metrics used by the
// sprint flow overview. It returns nil when the embedder does not expose the
// additive WebSprintUsageQueries capability, mirroring the behaviour used for
// the durable run page.
func (h *handler) loadSprintFlowUsage(ctx context.Context, project, slug string) *sprintStageUsageView {
	if project == "" || slug == "" || h.queries == nil {

	}
	usageQueries, ok := h.queries.(app.WebSprintUsageQueries)
	if !ok {

	}

	if err != nil {

	}
	view := newSprintStageUsageView(slug, metrics)
	if !view.HasMetrics {

	}
	return &view

func (h *handler) handleValidations(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	values, err := url.ParseQuery(r.URL.RawQuery)
	if err != nil || len(values) != 2 || len(values["scope"]) != 1 || len(values["ref"]) != 1 {
		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "Validation requires one scope and one ref.")
		return
	}
	scope, ref := values.Get("scope"), values.Get("ref")
	if (scope != "workspace" && scope != "project" && scope != "sprint" && scope != "study") || !validOpaqueRef(ref) {
		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "The validation query is invalid.")
		return
	}
	result, err := h.queries.Validations(r.Context(), scope, ref)
	if err != nil {
		h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
		return
	}
	h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"scope": result.Scope, "ref": result.Ref, "findings": mapFindings(result.Findings)}, &result.CollectionInfo)
}

func validIdentifier(value string) bool {
	return len(value) > 0 && len(value) <= MaxIdentifierBytes && value != "." && value != ".." &&
		!strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\`) && identifierPattern.MatchString(value)
}

func validOpaqueRef(value string) bool {
	return len(value) > 0 && len(value) <= MaxIdentifierBytes && opaqueRefPattern.MatchString(value)
}

func (h *handler) handleQueryError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, apiRoute bool, err error) {
	status, code, message := http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error", "The request could not be completed."
	if qaErr, ok := app.AsQAUseCaseError(err); ok {
		status, code, message = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, qaErr.Code, qaErr.Message
		switch qaErr.Code {
		case "qa.conflict":
			status = http.StatusConflict
		case "qa.persistence_failure", "qa.runtime_unavailable":
			status = http.StatusServiceUnavailable
		}
		if apiRoute {
			h.writeQAError(w, r, status, qaErr)
		} else {
			h.writeRouteError(w, r, false, status, code, message)
		}
		return
	}
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, app.ErrWebNotFound):
		status, code, message = http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "The requested resource was not found."
	case errors.Is(err, app.ErrWebUnavailable), errors.Is(err, context.Canceled), errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
		status, code, message = http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "The service is unavailable."
	}
	h.writeRouteError(w, r, apiRoute, status, code, message)
}

func (h *handler) writeQAError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, status int, qaErr *app.QAUseCaseError) {
	meta := responseMeta{APIVersion: "v1", RequestID: requestID(r.Context()), GeneratedAt: h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)}
	details := map[string]any{"category": qaErr.Category, "operation": qaErr.Operation, "guidance": qaErr.Guidance, "component": "sprint", "correlation_id": meta.RequestID}
	writeJSON(w, status, errorEnvelope{Error: errorBody{Code: qaErr.Code, Message: qaErr.Message, Retryable: qaErr.Retryable, Details: details}, Meta: meta})
}

func (h *handler) writeRouteError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, apiRoute bool, status int, code, message string) {
	if apiRoute {
		h.writeError(w, r, status, code, message)
		return
	}
	h.renderError(w, r, status, http.StatusText(status), message)
}

func (h *handler) writeSuccess(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, status int, data any, collection *app.CollectionInfo) {
	meta := responseMeta{APIVersion: "v1", RequestID: requestID(r.Context()), GeneratedAt: h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)}
	if collection != nil {
		meta.ReturnedCount = intPtr(collection.ReturnedCount)
		meta.TotalCount = intPtr(collection.TotalCount)
		meta.Truncated = boolPtr(collection.Truncated)
	}
	writeJSON(w, status, successEnvelope{Data: data, Meta: meta})
}

func (h *handler) writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, status int, code, message string) {
	writeJSONErrorResponse(w, requestID(r.Context()), status, code, message)
}

func writeJSONErrorResponse(w http.ResponseWriter, id string, status int, code, message string) {
	writeJSON(w, status, errorEnvelope{Error: errorBody{Code: code, Message: message}, Meta: responseMeta{APIVersion: "v1", RequestID: id}})
}

func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(&buf)
	encoder.SetEscapeHTML(true)
	if err := encoder.Encode(payload); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "response encoding failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Length", strconv.Itoa(buf.Len()))
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_, _ = w.Write(buf.Bytes())
}

func writePolicyError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, status int, code, message string) {
	if strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/") {
		writeJSONErrorResponse(w, requestID(r.Context()), status, code, message)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "<!doctype html><html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><title>Request rejected</title></head><body><main><h1>Request rejected</h1><p>%s</p></main></body></html>", templateText(message))
}

func templateText(value string) string {
	return template.HTMLEscapeString(value)
}

func (h *handler) render(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, status int, name string, page pageModel) {
	page.CSRF = csrfToken(r.Context())
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	if err := h.templates.ExecuteTemplate(&buf, "page/"+name, page); err != nil {
		http.Error(w, "page rendering failed", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Length", strconv.Itoa(buf.Len()))
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_, _ = w.Write(buf.Bytes())
}

func (h *handler) renderError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, status int, title, message string) {
	h.render(w, r, status, "error", pageModel{Title: title, Heading: title, Status: status, Error: message})
}

func mapProject(item app.WebProjectResult, includeSprints bool) projectDTO {
	out := projectDTO{Ref: item.Ref, Name: item.Name, Docs: nonNilSlice(item.Docs), Findings: mapFindings(item.Findings), Artifacts: mapArtifacts(item.Artifacts), Sprints: []sprintDTO{}, Roadmap: []roadmapPhaseDTO{}}
	if includeSprints {
		out.Sprints = mapSprints(item.Sprints)
	}
	for _, phase := range item.Roadmap {
		sprints := make([]roadmapSprintDTO, 0, len(phase.Sprints))
		for _, entry := range phase.Sprints {
			sprints = append(sprints, roadmapSprintDTO{
				Number: entry.Number, Title: entry.Title, Slug: entry.Slug, Status: entry.Status,
				Goal: entry.Goal, GateItems: nonNilSlice(entry.GateItems), DependsOn: nonNilSlice(entry.DependsOn),
				Exists: entry.Exists, Assessment: entry.Assessment,
				CompletedStages: entry.CompletedStages, TotalStages: entry.TotalStages, CurrentStage: entry.CurrentStage,
			})
		}
		out.Roadmap = append(out.Roadmap, roadmapPhaseDTO{Title: phase.Title, Sprints: sprints})
	}
	return out
}

func mapCollection(item app.CollectionInfo) collectionDTO {
	return collectionDTO{ReturnedCount: item.ReturnedCount, TotalCount: item.TotalCount, Truncated: item.Truncated}
}

func mapProjects(items []app.WebProjectResult, includeSprints bool) []projectDTO {
	out := make([]projectDTO, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		out = append(out, mapProject(item, includeSprints))
	}
	return out
}

func mapSprint(item app.WebSprintResult) sprintDTO {
	stages := make([]stageDTO, 0, len(item.Stages))
	for _, stage := range item.Stages {
		stages = append(stages, stageDTO{Name: stage.Name, Status: stage.Status, Error: stage.Error, ArtifactAvailable: stage.ArtifactAvailable, ArtifactValid: stage.ArtifactValid, LatestOutcome: stage.LatestOutcome, NextAction: stage.NextAction})
	}
	reviewers := make([]reviewerDTO, 0, len(item.Review.Reviewers))
	for _, reviewer := range item.Review.Reviewers {
		reviewers = append(reviewers, reviewerDTO{ID: reviewer.ID, Name: reviewer.Name, Kind: reviewer.Kind, Path: reviewer.Path, Status: reviewer.Status, Summary: reviewer.Summary})
	}
	return sprintDTO{
		Ref: item.Ref, Project: item.Project, Slug: item.Slug, Status: item.Status,
		Assessment: item.Assessment, NextAction: item.NextAction, Stages: stages,
		Execute:  executeDTO{Available: item.Execute.Available, Total: item.Execute.Total, Pending: item.Execute.Pending, Running: item.Execute.Running, Complete: item.Execute.Complete, Failed: item.Execute.Failed, Cancelled: item.Execute.Cancelled},
		Review:   reviewDTO{Available: item.Review.Available, Status: item.Review.Status, Verdict: item.Review.Verdict, Stale: item.Review.Stale, Completed: item.Review.Completed, Total: item.Review.Total, Pending: item.Review.Pending, Running: item.Review.Running, Failed: item.Review.Failed, Reviewers: reviewers, StartedAt: item.Review.StartedAt},
		Smoke:    smokeDTO{Available: item.Smoke.Available, Status: item.Smoke.Status, Verdict: item.Smoke.Verdict, Stale: item.Smoke.Stale, RunID: item.Smoke.RunID},
		QA:       item.QA,
		Findings: mapFindings(item.Findings), Artifacts: mapArtifacts(item.Artifacts),
	}
}

func mapPromptBundle(item app.WebPromptBundleResult) promptBundleDTO {
	contract := promptInputContractDTO{
		Stage: string(item.InputContract.Stage), Required: item.InputContract.Required,
		Optional: item.InputContract.Optional, Forbidden: item.InputContract.Forbidden,
	}
	out := promptBundleDTO{
		Stage: string(item.Stage), Available: item.Available, Scope: item.Scope,
		UnavailableReason: item.UnavailableReason, InputContract: contract, Blocks: []promptBlockDTO{},
	}
	if item.Explanation == nil {
		return out
	}
	explanation := item.Explanation
	out.SchemaVersion = explanation.SchemaVersion
	out.TotalBytes = explanation.TotalBytes
	out.SharedPrefixBytes = explanation.SharedPrefixBytes
	out.StageSuffixBytes = explanation.StageSuffixBytes
	out.SharedPrefixDigest = explanation.SharedPrefixDigest
	out.CacheKey = explanation.CacheKey
	out.CacheBreakpointBytes = explanation.CacheBreakpoint
	out.CacheCandidate = explanation.CacheCandidate
	out.CacheTransport = explanation.CacheTransport
	for index, block := range explanation.Blocks {
		content := ""
		if index < len(item.BlockContents) {
			content = item.BlockContents[index]
		}
		out.Blocks = append(out.Blocks, promptBlockDTO{ID: block.ID, Kind: block.Kind, Mode: block.Mode, Cacheable: block.Cacheable, Bytes: block.Bytes, Digest: block.Digest, Content: content})
	}
	return out
}

func mapSprints(items []app.WebSprintResult) []sprintDTO {
	out := make([]sprintDTO, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		out = append(out, mapSprint(item))
	}
	return out
}

func mapStudyParallelism(item *app.ParallelismSummary) *studyParallelismDTO {
	if item == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return &studyParallelismDTO{Decreased: item.Decreased, Events: item.Events, RequestedParallelism: item.RequestedParallelism, EffectiveParallelism: item.EffectiveParallelism}
}

func mapStudy(item app.WebStudyResult) studyDTO {
	retries := studyRetryDTO{RetriedTasks: item.Retries.RetriedTasks, TotalRetries: item.Retries.TotalRetries, SameSession: item.Retries.SameSession, FreshSession: item.Retries.FreshSession, Waiting: item.Retries.Waiting}
	if item.Retries.NextRetryAt != nil {
		next := *item.Retries.NextRetryAt
		retries.NextRetryAt = &next
	}
	retried := make([]studyTaskRetryDTO, 0, len(item.RetriedTasks))
	for _, task := range item.RetriedTasks {
		retried = append(retried, studyTaskRetryDTO{ID: task.ID, Kind: task.Kind, Status: task.Status, Retries: task.Retries, SessionReuse: task.SessionReuse})
	}
	var failures []studyTaskFailureDTO
	for _, task := range item.Tasks {
		if task.Error != "" {
			failures = append(failures, studyTaskFailureDTO{Task: task.ID, Code: task.ErrorCode, Message: task.Error})
		}
	}
	return studyDTO{Ref: item.Ref, Name: item.Name, Sources: nonNilSlice(item.Sources), Dimensions: nonNilSlice(item.Dimensions), Status: item.Status, RunID: item.RunID, Total: item.Total, Completed: item.Completed, Failed: item.Failed, RunActive: item.RunActive, ActiveTasks: item.ActiveTasks, Pending: item.Pending, Cancelled: item.Cancelled, Retries: retries, Parallelism: mapStudyParallelism(item.Parallelism), RetriedTasks: retried, Failures: failures, Findings: mapFindings(item.Findings), Artifacts: mapArtifacts(item.Artifacts)}
}

func mapStudies(items []app.WebStudyResult) []studyDTO {
	out := make([]studyDTO, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		out = append(out, mapStudy(item))
	}
	return out
}

func mapFindings(items []app.DisplayFinding) []findingDTO {
	out := make([]findingDTO, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		out = append(out, findingDTO{Severity: item.Severity, Section: item.Section, Problem: item.Problem, Cause: item.Cause, Suggestion: item.Suggestion})
	}
	return out
}

func mapArtifacts(items []app.WebArtifactLink) []artifactDTO {
	out := make([]artifactDTO, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		out = append(out, artifactDTO{Ref: item.Ref, Label: item.Label, DisplayPath: item.DisplayPath, MediaType: item.MediaType})
	}
	return out
}

func mapArtifactPreview(item app.WebArtifactPreview) artifactPreviewDTO {
	out := artifactPreviewDTO{Ref: item.Ref, DisplayPath: item.DisplayPath, MediaType: item.MediaType, Content: item.Content, SizeBytes: item.SizeBytes, ReturnedBytes: item.ReturnedBytes, Truncated: item.Truncated}
	if item.MediaType == "application/json" {
		out.JSONValid = boolPtr(item.JSONValid)
	}
	return out
}

func nonNilSlice[T any](items []T) []T {
	if items == nil {
		return []T{}
	}
	return items
}

func newestSprintsFirst(items []app.WebSprintResult) []app.WebSprintResult {
	out := append([]app.WebSprintResult(nil), items...)
	for left, right := 0, len(out)-1; left < right; left, right = left+1, right-1 {
		out[left], out[right] = out[right], out[left]
	}
	return out
}

// handleSprintCreate materializes a roadmap sprint workspace directory and
// returns the browser straight to the sprint page.
func (h *handler) handleSprintCreate(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, projectName string) {
	if err := r.ParseForm(); err != nil || r.FormValue("_csrf") != csrfToken(r.Context()) {
		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusForbidden, "Request rejected", "The browser session or CSRF proof is invalid. Refresh the page and try again.")
		return
	}
	mutation, ok := h.queries.(app.WebSprintWorkspaceMutation)
	if !ok {
		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Unavailable", "Sprint workspace creation is unavailable on this surface.")
		return
	}
	slug := r.FormValue("sprint")
	if !validOptionalIdentifier(projectName) || projectName == "" || !validIdentifier(slug) {
		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "Invalid sprint", "The project or sprint reference is not a single safe path segment.")
		return
	}
	if err := mutation.CreateSprintWorkspace(r.Context(), projectName, slug); err != nil {
		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, "Creation failed", htmlOperationFailure("The sprint workspace could not be created from the roadmap slug.", err))
		return
	}
	http.Redirect(w, r, "/projects/"+projectName+"/sprints/"+slug, http.StatusSeeOther)
}

838: func (h *handler) loadRepoBoard(r *http.Request, name string, model *pageModel) error {
839: 	queries, ok := h.queries.(app.WebStudyReportQueries)
840: 	if !ok {
841: 		return app.ErrWebUnavailable
842: 	}
843: 	result, err := queries.StudyRepos(r.Context(), name)
844: 	if err != nil {
845: 		return err
846: 	}
847: 	byName := make(map[string]app.WebRepoScore, len(result.Repos))
848: 	for _, repo := range result.Repos {
849: 		byName[repo.Name] = repo
850: 	}
851: 	labels := make(map[string]string)
852: 	columns := make([]string, 0)
853: 	for _, repo := range result.Repos {
854: 		for _, entry := range repo.Scores {
855: 			if _, seen := labels[entry.Number]; !seen {
856: 				labels[entry.Number] = entry.Dimension
857: 				columns = append(columns, entry.Number)
858: 			}
859: 		}
860: 	}
861: 	sort.Strings(columns)
862: 	topScores := make(map[string]int, len(columns))
863: 	for _, number := range columns {
864: 		best := 0
865: 		for _, repo := range result.Repos {
866: 			for _, score := range repo.Scores {
867: 				if score.Number == number && score.Score > best {
868: 					best = score.Score
869: 				}
870: 			}
871: 		}
872: 		topScores[number] = best
873: 	}
874: 	for _, number := range columns {
875: 		model.RepoColumns = append(model.RepoColumns, repoMatrixColumn{Number: number, Label: labels[number]})
876: 	}
877: 	for index, repo := range result.Repos {
878: 		entry := repoBoardEntry{
879: 			Rank:     index + 1,
880: 			Name:     repo.Name,
881: 			Coverage: fmt.Sprintf("%d / %d dimensions rated", repo.RatedCount, repo.Applicable),
882: 		}
883: 		if repo.RatedCount > 0 {
884: 			entry.Average = strconv.FormatFloat(repo.Average, 'f', 1, 64)
885: 			entry.BarWidth = int(math.Round(repo.Average * 10))
886: 		} else {
887: 			entry.Average = "-"
888: 		}
889: 		if repo.Best != nil {
890: 			entry.BestRef = repo.Best.Ref
891: 			entry.BestText = repo.Best.Dimension + " · " + strconv.Itoa(repo.Best.Score)
892: 		}
893: 		model.RepoBoard = append(model.RepoBoard, entry)
894: 
895: 		scoreByName := byName[repo.Name]
896: 		applicable := make(map[string]bool, len(scoreByName.ApplicableNumbers))
897: 		for _, number := range scoreByName.ApplicableNumbers {
898: 			applicable[number] = true
899: 		}
900: 		row := repoMatrixRow{Name: repo.Name, Average: entry.Average}
901: 		for _, column := range columns {
902: 			cell := repoMatrixCell{Label: "n/a"}
903: 			if applicable[column] {
904: 				cell = repoMatrixCell{Label: "–"}
905: 			}
906: 			for _, score := range scoreByName.Scores {
907: 				if score.Number == column {
908: 					cell = repoMatrixCell{Label: strconv.Itoa(score.Score), Scored: true, Percent: score.Score * 10, Leader: topScores[column] > 0 && score.Score == topScores[column], Ref: score.Ref}
909: 					break
910: 				}
911: 			}
912: 			row.Cells = append(row.Cells, cell)
913: 		}
914: 		model.RepoMatrix = append(model.RepoMatrix, row)
915: 	}
916: 	for _, dimension := range result.Dimensions {
917: 		champion := repoChampion{Dimension: dimension.Dimension}
918: 		for _, leader := range dimension.Leaders {
919: 			champion.Leaders = append(champion.Leaders, repoLeaderView{Rank: leader.Rank, Name: leader.Name, Score: leader.Score, Ref: leader.Ref})
920: 		}
921: 		model.RepoChampions = append(model.RepoChampions, champion)
922: 	}
923: 	return nil
924: }

390: func makeProjectRoadmapPreview(project app.WebProjectResult) *projectRoadmapPreview {
391: 	preview := &projectRoadmapPreview{}
392: 	var nextPlanned *app.WebRoadmapSprint
393: 	for _, phase := range project.Roadmap {
394: 		for _, sprint := range phase.Sprints {
395: 			preview.Total++
396: 			if sprint.Status == "delivered" {
397: 				preview.Completed++
398: 				if preview.Previous == nil || sprint.Number > preview.Previous.Number {
399: 					copy := sprint
400: 					preview.Previous = &copy
401: 				}
402: 				continue
403: 			}
404: 			if sprint.Status == "active" && (preview.Next == nil || preview.Next.Status != "active" || sprint.Number < preview.Next.Number) {
405: 				copy := sprint
406: 				preview.Next = &copy
407: 				continue
408: 			}
409: 			if nextPlanned == nil || sprint.Number < nextPlanned.Number {
410: 				copy := sprint
411: 				nextPlanned = &copy
412: 			}
413: 		}
414: 	}
415: 	if preview.Next == nil {
416: 		preview.Next = nextPlanned
417: 	}
418: 	return preview
419: }

425: 		return

838: func (h *handler) loadRepoBoard(r *http.Request, name string, model *pageModel) error {
839: 	queries, ok := h.queries.(app.WebStudyReportQueries)
840: 	if !ok {
841: 		return app.ErrWebUnavailable
842: 	}
843: 	result, err := queries.StudyRepos(r.Context(), name)
844: 	if err != nil {
845: 		return err
846: 	}
847: 	byName := make(map[string]app.WebRepoScore, len(result.Repos))
848: 	for _, repo := range result.Repos {
849: 		byName[repo.Name] = repo
850: 	}
851: 	labels := make(map[string]string)
852: 	columns := make([]string, 0)
853: 	for _, repo := range result.Repos {
854: 		for _, entry := range repo.Scores {
855: 			if _, seen := labels[entry.Number]; !seen {
856: 				labels[entry.Number] = entry.Dimension
857: 				columns = append(columns, entry.Number)
858: 			}
859: 		}
860: 	}
861: 	sort.Strings(columns)
862: 	topScores := make(map[string]int, len(columns))
863: 	for _, number := range columns {
864: 		best := 0
865: 		for _, repo := range result.Repos {
866: 			for _, score := range repo.Scores {
867: 				if score.Number == number && score.Score > best {
868: 					best = score.Score
869: 				}
870: 			}
871: 		}
872: 		topScores[number] = best
873: 	}
874: 	for _, number := range columns {
875: 		model.RepoColumns = append(model.RepoColumns, repoMatrixColumn{Number: number, Label: labels[number]})
876: 	}
877: 	for index, repo := range result.Repos {
878: 		entry := repoBoardEntry{
879: 			Rank:     index + 1,
880: 			Name:     repo.Name,
881: 			Coverage: fmt.Sprintf("%d / %d dimensions rated", repo.RatedCount, repo.Applicable),
882: 		}
883: 		if repo.RatedCount > 0 {
884: 			entry.Average = strconv.FormatFloat(repo.Average, 'f', 1, 64)
885: 			entry.BarWidth = int(math.Round(repo.Average * 10))
886: 		} else {
887: 			entry.Average = "-"
888: 		}
889: 		if repo.Best != nil {
890: 			entry.BestRef = repo.Best.Ref
891: 			entry.BestText = repo.Best.Dimension + " · " + strconv.Itoa(repo.Best.Score)
892: 		}
893: 		model.RepoBoard = append(model.RepoBoard, entry)
894: 
895: 		scoreByName := byName[repo.Name]
896: 		applicable := make(map[string]bool, len(scoreByName.ApplicableNumbers))
897: 		for _, number := range scoreByName.ApplicableNumbers {
898: 			applicable[number] = true
899: 		}
900: 		row := repoMatrixRow{Name: repo.Name, Average: entry.Average}
901: 		for _, column := range columns {
902: 			cell := repoMatrixCell{Label: "n/a"}
903: 			if applicable[column] {
904: 				cell = repoMatrixCell{Label: "–"}
905: 			}
906: 			for _, score := range scoreByName.Scores {
907: 				if score.Number == column {
908: 					cell = repoMatrixCell{Label: strconv.Itoa(score.Score), Scored: true, Percent: score.Score * 10, Leader: topScores[column] > 0 && score.Score == topScores[column], Ref: score.Ref}
909: 					break
910: 				}
911: 			}
912: 			row.Cells = append(row.Cells, cell)
913: 		}
914: 		model.RepoMatrix = append(model.RepoMatrix, row)
915: 	}
916: 	for _, dimension := range result.Dimensions {
917: 		champion := repoChampion{Dimension: dimension.Dimension}
918: 		for _, leader := range dimension.Leaders {
919: 			champion.Leaders = append(champion.Leaders, repoLeaderView{Rank: leader.Rank, Name: leader.Name, Score: leader.Score, Ref: leader.Ref})
920: 		}
921: 		model.RepoChampions = append(model.RepoChampions, champion)
922: 	}
923: 	return nil
924: }

1016: func (h *handler) handleValidations(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
1017: 	values, err := url.ParseQuery(r.URL.RawQuery)
1018: 	if err != nil || len(values) != 2 || len(values["scope"]) != 1 || len(values["ref"]) != 1 {
1019: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "Validation requires one scope and one ref.")
1020: 		return
1021: 	}
1022: 	scope, ref := values.Get("scope"), values.Get("ref")
1023: 	if (scope != "workspace" && scope != "project" && scope != "sprint" && scope != "study") || !validOpaqueRef(ref) {
1024: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "The validation query is invalid.")
1025: 		return
1026: 	}
1027: 	result, err := h.queries.Validations(r.Context(), scope, ref)
1028: 	if err != nil {
1029: 		h.handleQueryError(w, r, true, err)
1030: 		return
1031: 	}
1032: 	h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"scope": result.Scope, "ref": result.Ref, "findings": mapFindings(result.Findings)}, &result.CollectionInfo)
1033: }

1044: func (h *handler) handleQueryError(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, apiRoute bool, err error) {
1045: 	status, code, message := http.StatusInternalServerError, "internal_error", "The request could not be completed."
1046: 	if qaErr, ok := app.AsQAUseCaseError(err); ok {
1047: 		status, code, message = http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, qaErr.Code, qaErr.Message
1048: 		switch qaErr.Code {
1049: 		case "qa.conflict":
1050: 			status = http.StatusConflict
1051: 		case "qa.persistence_failure", "qa.runtime_unavailable":
1052: 			status = http.StatusServiceUnavailable
1053: 		}
1054: 		if apiRoute {
1055: 			h.writeQAError(w, r, status, qaErr)
1056: 		} else {
1057: 			h.writeRouteError(w, r, false, status, code, message)
1058: 		}
1059: 		return
1060: 	}
1061: 	switch {
1062: 	case errors.Is(err, app.ErrWebNotFound):
1063: 		status, code, message = http.StatusNotFound, "not_found", "The requested resource was not found."
1064: 	case errors.Is(err, app.ErrWebUnavailable), errors.Is(err, context.Canceled), errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded):
1065: 		status, code, message = http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unavailable", "The service is unavailable."
1066: 	}
1067: 	h.writeRouteError(w, r, apiRoute, status, code, message)
1068: }

1071: 	meta := responseMeta{APIVersion: "v1", RequestID: requestID(r.Context()), GeneratedAt: h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)}
1072: 	details := map[string]any{"category": qaErr.Category, "operation": qaErr.Operation, "guidance": qaErr.Guidance, "component": "sprint", "correlation_id": meta.RequestID}
1073: 	writeJSON(w, status, errorEnvelope{Error: errorBody{Code: qaErr.Code, Message: qaErr.Message, Retryable: qaErr.Retryable, Details: details}, Meta: meta})
1074: }

249: func (h *handler) handleRuns(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
250: 	if h.runs == nil {
251: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "run_control_unavailable", "Durable run observation is unavailable.")
252: 		return
253: 	}
254: 	values := r.URL.Query()
255: 	if !onlyQueryKeys(values, "project", "sprint", "study", "lifecycle", "limit", "after") {
256: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "Unknown query parameters are not accepted.")
257: 		return
258: 	}
259: 	limit := 50
260: 	if text := values.Get("limit"); text != "" {
261: 		parsed, err := strconv.Atoi(text)
262: 		if err != nil || parsed < 1 || parsed > 200 {
263: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_limit", "The run limit must be between 1 and 200.")
264: 			return
265: 		}
266: 		limit = parsed
267: 	}
268: 	lifecycles, err := webLifecycleFilter(values.Get("lifecycle"))
269: 	if err != nil {
270: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_lifecycle", "The lifecycle filter contains an unknown value.")
271: 		return
272: 	}
273: 	page, err := h.runs.Runs(r.Context(), app.RunQuery{
274: 		Lifecycle: lifecycles, Project: values.Get("project"), Sprint: values.Get("sprint"), Study: values.Get("study"),
275: 		Limit: limit, After: values.Get("after"),
276: 	})
277: 	if err != nil {
278: 		h.handleRunControlError(w, r, err)
279: 		return
280: 	}
281: 	h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, page, nil)

322: func (h *handler) handleRunPage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, value string) {
323: 	if h.runs == nil {
324: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Run unavailable", "Durable run observation is unavailable.")
325: 		return
326: 	}
327: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(value))
328: 	if err != nil {
329: 		status := http.StatusServiceUnavailable
330: 		if errors.Is(err, app.ErrRunNotFound) {
331: 			status = http.StatusNotFound
332: 		}
333: 		h.renderError(w, r, status, "Run unavailable", "The durable run is unavailable or no longer retained.")
334: 		return
335: 	}
336: 	after := uint64(0)
337: 	if snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence > 1 {
338: 		after = snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence - 1
339: 	}
340: 	events, err := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 200)
341: 	if err != nil {
342: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Run unavailable", "The retained event journal could not be read.")
343: 		return
344: 	}
345: 	if len(events) > 200 {
346: 		events = events[:200]
347: 	}
348: 	nextEventsURL := ""
349: 	if len(events) > 0 && events[len(events)-1].Sequence < snapshot.LastSequence {
350: 		nextEventsURL = "/api/v1/runs/" + url.PathEscape(value) + "/events?after=" + strconv.FormatUint(events[len(events)-1].Sequence, 10)
351: 	}
352: 	detail := newRunDetailView(snapshot)
353: 	var insights *runStudyInsightsView
354: 	if snapshot.Target.Study != "" && h.queries != nil {
355: 		if study, err := h.queries.Study(r.Context(), snapshot.Target.Study); err == nil {
356: 			insights = newRunStudyInsightsView(snapshot.Target.Study, study)
357: 		}
358: 	}
359: 	var sprintUsage *runSprintUsageView
360: 	if snapshot.Target.Sprint != "" && snapshot.Target.Project != "" && h.queries != nil {
361: 		if usageQueries, ok := h.queries.(app.WebSprintUsageQueries); ok {
362: 			if metrics, err := usageQueries.SprintRuntimeUsage(r.Context(), snapshot.Target.Project, snapshot.Target.Sprint); err == nil {
363: 				summary := newRunSprintUsageView(snapshot.Target.Sprint, metrics)
364: 				sprintUsage = &summary
365: 			}
366: 		}
367: 	}
368: 	var qaInsights *runQAInsightsView
369: 	if isQARunTarget(snapshot.Target) {
370: 		qaInsights = h.newRunQAInsightsView(r, snapshot)
371: 	}
372: 	eventViews := make([]runEventView, 0, len(events))
373: 	for _, event := range events {
374: 		eventViews = append(eventViews, newRunEventView(event))
375: 	}
376: 	h.render(w, r, http.StatusOK, "run", pageModel{Title: "Run " + value, Heading: "Run detail", Run: &detail, StudyInsights: insights, SprintUsage: sprintUsage, QAInsights: qaInsights, RunEvents: eventViews, NextEventsURL: nextEventsURL, Page: "run", SurfaceContract: runSurfaceContract})
377: }

383: func (h *handler) newRunQAInsightsView(r *http.Request, snapshot app.RunSnapshot) *runQAInsightsView {
384: 	view := &runQAInsightsView{Project: snapshot.Target.Project, Sprint: snapshot.Target.Sprint}
385: 	view.StatusURL = "/api/v1/projects/" + url.PathEscape(view.Project) + "/sprints/" + url.PathEscape(view.Sprint) + "/qa"
386: 	view.SynthesisURL = view.StatusURL + "/synthesis"
387: 	if h.qa == nil {
388: 		view.Unavailable = "The canonical QA reader is unavailable. The durable event journal remains authoritative for this run."
389: 		return view
390: 	}
391: 	qa, err := h.qa.QAStatus(r.Context(), app.QARequest{Project: view.Project, Sprint: view.Sprint})
392: 	if err != nil {
393: 		view.Unavailable = "The canonical QA snapshot could not be read. The durable event journal remains available below."
394: 		return view
395: 	}
396: 	view.QA = qa
397: 	view.ProgressMax = qa.TotalShards
398: 	if view.ProgressMax < 1 {
399: 		view.ProgressMax = 1
400: 	}
401: 	if qa.RunID != "" && qa.RunID != string(snapshot.RunID) {
402: 		view.Historical = true
403: 		view.CurrentRunID = qa.RunID
404: 		return view
405: 	}
406: 	if qa.TotalShards > 0 {
407: 		view.CompletionPercent = qa.CompletedShards * 100 / qa.TotalShards
408: 	}
409: 	keys := make([]string, 0, len(qa.OutcomeTotals))
410: 	for key := range qa.OutcomeTotals {
411: 		keys = append(keys, key)
412: 	}
413: 	sort.Strings(keys)
414: 	for _, key := range keys {
415: 		view.Outcomes = append(view.Outcomes, runQACountView{Label: key, Value: qa.OutcomeTotals[key]})
416: 	}
417: 	for _, shard := range qa.Shards {
418: 		view.ApprovedChecks += len(shard.ApprovedChecks)
419: 		view.Attempts += len(shard.Attempts)
420: 		view.Theories += len(shard.Theories)
421: 		for _, attempt := range shard.Attempts {
422: 			view.Commands += len(attempt.Commands)
423: 			view.ContextRequests += len(attempt.ContextRequests)
424: 			view.Evidence += len(attempt.Evidence)
425: 		}
426: 		for _, theory := range shard.Theories {
427: 			view.Evidence += len(theory.Evidence)
428: 		}
429: 	}
430: 	synthesis, err := h.qa.QASynthesis(r.Context(), app.QARequest{Project: view.Project, Sprint: view.Sprint})
431: 	if err != nil {
432: 		view.SynthesisUnavailable = "The retained synthesis could not be read."
433: 		return view
434: 	}
435: 	view.Synthesis = synthesis
436: 	view.HasSynthesis = synthesis.ID != ""
437: 	return view
438: }

576: func newSprintStageUsageView(slug string, metrics app.SprintMetricsSummary) sprintStageUsageView {
577: 	view := sprintStageUsageView{runUsageView: runUsageView{Scope: slug, cacheHitComplete: true}, UpdatedAt: metrics.UpdatedAt}
578: 	type stageAgg struct {
579: 		runs             int
580: 		tokens           int64
581: 		tokensKnown      bool
582: 		cacheRead        int64
583: 		cacheReadKnown   bool
584: 		cacheWrite       int64
585: 		cacheWriteKnown  bool
586: 		cost             float64
587: 		costKnown        bool
588: 		providerReported int
589: 		modelPriced      int
590: 	}
591: 	agg := map[string]*stageAgg{}
592: 	for _, run := range metrics.RecentRuns {
593: 		view.addTokens(run.InputKnown, run.Input, run.OutputKnown, run.Output, run.ReasoningKnown, run.Reasoning,
594: 			run.CacheReadKnown, run.CacheRead, run.CacheWriteKnown, run.CacheWrite, run.TotalKnown, run.Total)
595: 		view.addCost(run.CostKnown, run.CostAmount, run.CostSource)
596: 		a, ok := agg[run.Stage]
597: 		if !ok {
598: 			a = &stageAgg{}
599: 			agg[run.Stage] = a
600: 		}
601: 		a.runs++
602: 		if run.TotalKnown {
603: 			a.tokens += run.Total
604: 			a.tokensKnown = true
605: 		}
606: 		if run.CacheReadKnown {
607: 			a.cacheRead += run.CacheRead
608: 			a.cacheReadKnown = true
609: 		}
610: 		if run.CacheWriteKnown {
611: 			a.cacheWrite += run.CacheWrite
612: 			a.cacheWriteKnown = true
613: 		}
614: 		if run.CostKnown {
615: 			a.cost += run.CostAmount
616: 			a.costKnown = true
617: 			switch run.CostSource {
618: 			case "model_priced":
619: 				a.modelPriced++
620: 			case "provider_reported":
621: 				a.providerReported++
622: 			}
623: 		}
624: 	}
625: 	seen := map[string]bool{}
626: 	emit := func(name string) {
627: 		if seen[name] {
628: 			return
629: 		}
630: 		seen[name] = true
631: 		a, ok := agg[name]
632: 		if !ok {
633: 			return
634: 		}
635: 		tokens := "-"
636: 		if a.tokensKnown {
637: 			tokens = strconv.FormatInt(a.tokens, 10)
638: 		}
639: 		cacheR := "-"
640: 		if a.cacheReadKnown {
641: 			cacheR = strconv.FormatInt(a.cacheRead, 10)
642: 		}
643: 		cacheW := "-"
644: 		if a.cacheWriteKnown {
645: 			cacheW = strconv.FormatInt(a.cacheWrite, 10)
646: 		}
647: 		cost := "-"
648: 		costNote := ""
649: 		if a.costKnown {
650: 			suffix := ""
651: 			if a.modelPriced > 0 {
652: 				suffix = "*"
653: 			}
654: 			cost = formatRunUSD(a.cost) + suffix
655: 			if a.modelPriced > 0 && a.providerReported > 0 {
656: 				costNote = "mixed"
657: 			} else if a.modelPriced > 0 {
658: 				costNote = "rate-table estimate"
659: 			} else if a.providerReported > 0 {
660: 				costNote = "provider reported"
661: 			}
662: 		}
663: 		view.Rows = append(view.Rows, sprintStageUsageRow{Stage: name, Runs: a.runs, Tokens: tokens, CacheR: cacheR, CacheW: cacheW, Cost: cost, CostNote: costNote})
664: 	}
665: 	for _, name := range sprintStageOrder() {
666: 		emit(name)
667: 	}
668: 	for name := range agg {
669: 		emit(name)
670: 	}
671: 	finalizeRunUsageView(&view.runUsageView)
672: 	view.HasMetrics = len(metrics.RecentRuns) > 0
673: 	return view
674: }

931: func (h *handler) handleRunEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, value string) {
932: 	if h.runs == nil {
933: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "run_control_unavailable", "Durable run replay is unavailable.")
934: 		return
935: 	}
936: 	values := r.URL.Query()
937: 	if !onlyQueryKeys(values, "after") {
938: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "Unknown query parameters are not accepted.")
939: 		return
940: 	}
941: 	afterValue, queryHasAfter := values["after"]
942: 	headerAfter := strings.TrimSpace(r.Header.Get("Last-Event-ID"))
943: 	if queryHasAfter && headerAfter != "" {
944: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "cursor_conflict", "Use either Last-Event-ID or after, not both.")
945: 		return
946: 	}
947: 	cursor := "0"
948: 	if queryHasAfter {
949: 		if len(afterValue) != 1 {
950: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_cursor", "The event cursor must be one decimal sequence.")
951: 			return
952: 		}
953: 		cursor = afterValue[0]
954: 	} else if headerAfter != "" {
955: 		cursor = headerAfter
956: 	}
957: 	after, err := strconv.ParseUint(cursor, 10, 64)
958: 	if err != nil {
959: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_cursor", "The event cursor must be a non-negative decimal sequence.")
960: 		return
961: 	}
962: 	runID := app.RunID(value)
963: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), runID)
964: 	if err != nil {
965: 		h.handleRunControlError(w, r, err)
966: 		return
967: 	}
968: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
969: 		h.writeErrorDetails(w, r, http.StatusConflict, errorBody{Code: "cursor_ahead", Message: "The event cursor is ahead of the durable run.", Details: map[string]any{
970: 			"requested": after, "last": snapshot.LastSequence, "run": snapshot,
971: 		}})
972: 		return
973: 	}
974: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
975: 		h.writeErrorDetails(w, r, http.StatusConflict, errorBody{Code: "replay_gap", Message: "The requested event history is no longer retained.", Details: map[string]any{
976: 			"requested": after, "oldest": snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence, "last": snapshot.LastSequence,
977: 			"reason": "retention_or_compaction", "run": snapshot, "recovery": []string{"refresh_snapshot", "resume_from_oldest"},
978: 		}})
979: 		return
980: 	}
981: 	if !strings.Contains(r.Header.Get("Accept"), "text/event-stream") {
982: 		events, err := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), runID, after, 512)
983: 		if err != nil {
984: 			h.handleRunControlError(w, r, err)
985: 			return
986: 		}
987: 		h.writeSuccess(w, r, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"run": snapshot, "events": events}, nil)
988: 		return
989: 	}
990: 	h.followRunSSE(w, r, snapshot, after)
991: }

993: func (h *handler) followRunSSE(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, snapshot app.RunSnapshot, after uint64) {
994: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
995: 	if !ok {
996: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusInternalServerError, "stream_unavailable", "Streaming is unavailable.")
997: 		return
998: 	}
999: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
1000: 	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
1001: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
1002: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
1003: 	flusher.Flush()
1004: 	idle := time.NewTimer(0)
1005: 	if !idle.Stop() {
1006: 		<-idle.C
1007: 	}
1008: 	defer idle.Stop()
1009: 	for {
1010: 		events, err := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
1011: 		if err != nil {
1012: 			return
1013: 		}
1014: 		for _, event := range events {
1015: 			encoded, err := json.Marshal(event)
1016: 			if err != nil {
1017: 				return
1018: 			}
1019: 			if _, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "id: %d\nevent: run\ndata: %s\n\n", event.Sequence, encoded); err != nil {
1020: 				return
1021: 			}
1022: 			after = event.Sequence
1023: 		}
1024: 		flusher.Flush()
1025: 		current, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
1026: 		if err != nil {
1027: 			return
1028: 		}
1029: 		if current.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= current.LastSequence {
1030: 			return
1031: 		}
1032: 		wait := time.Second
1033: 		if len(events) == 512 || after < current.LastSequence {
1034: 			wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
1035: 		}
1036: 		idle.Reset(wait)
1037: 		select {
1038: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
1039: 			return
1040: 		case <-idle.C:
1041: 			if _, err := fmt.Fprint(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
1042: 				return
1043: 			}
1044: 			flusher.Flush()
1045: 		}
1046: 	}
1047: }

1050: 	switch {

1053: 	case errors.Is(err, app.ErrRunNotFound):

1055: 	case errors.Is(err, app.ErrRunConflict):
1056: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "run_conflict", "The durable run changed concurrently.")
1057: 	case errors.Is(err, app.ErrRunUnsupportedSchema):
1058: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "unsupported_run_schema", "The run-control schema requires a matching UltraPlan binary.")

1060: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "run_control_unavailable", "The durable run repository is unavailable.")

189: 	if totalKnown {
190: 		v.Total += total
191: 		v.TotalKnown = true
192: 	}
193: }

195: func (v *runUsageView) addCost(known bool, amount float64, source string) {
196: 	switch source {
197: 	case "provider_reported", "model_priced":
198: 	case "":
199: 		source = "provider_reported"
200: 	default:
201: 		source = ""
202: 	}
203: 	if !known {
204: 		if v.HasUsage {
205: 			v.TasksUnpriced++
206: 		}
207: 		return
208: 	}
209: 	v.cost += amount
210: 	v.costKnown = true
211: 	v.TasksPriced++
212: 	switch source {
213: 	case "model_priced":
214: 		v.ModelPriced++
215: 	case "provider_reported":
216: 		v.ProviderReported++
217: 	default:
218: 		v.TasksUnpriced++
219: 	}
220: }

252: 		return
253: 	}
254: 	values := r.URL.Query()
255: 	if !onlyQueryKeys(values, "project", "sprint", "study", "lifecycle", "limit", "after") {
256: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request", "Unknown query parameters are not accepted.")
257: 		return
258: 	}

261: 		parsed, err := strconv.Atoi(text)
262: 		if err != nil || parsed < 1 || parsed > 200 {
263: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_limit", "The run limit must be between 1 and 200.")
264: 			return
265: 		}
266: 		limit = parsed
267: 	}
268: 	lifecycles, err := webLifecycleFilter(values.Get("lifecycle"))
269: 	if err != nil {
270: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_lifecycle", "The lifecycle filter contains an unknown value.")

322: func (h *handler) handleRunPage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, value string) {
323: 	if h.runs == nil {
324: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Run unavailable", "Durable run observation is unavailable.")
325: 		return
326: 	}
327: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(value))
328: 	if err != nil {
329: 		status := http.StatusServiceUnavailable
330: 		if errors.Is(err, app.ErrRunNotFound) {
331: 			status = http.StatusNotFound
332: 		}
333: 		h.renderError(w, r, status, "Run unavailable", "The durable run is unavailable or no longer retained.")
334: 		return
335: 	}
336: 	after := uint64(0)
337: 	if snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence > 1 {
338: 		after = snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence - 1
339: 	}
340: 	events, err := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 200)
341: 	if err != nil {
342: 		h.renderError(w, r, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "Run unavailable", "The retained event journal could not be read.")
343: 		return
344: 	}
345: 	if len(events) > 200 {
346: 		events = events[:200]
347: 	}
348: 	nextEventsURL := ""
349: 	if len(events) > 0 && events[len(events)-1].Sequence < snapshot.LastSequence {
350: 		nextEventsURL = "/api/v1/runs/" + url.PathEscape(value) + "/events?after=" + strconv.FormatUint(events[len(events)-1].Sequence, 10)
351: 	}
352: 	detail := newRunDetailView(snapshot)
353: 	var insights *runStudyInsightsView
354: 	if snapshot.Target.Study != "" && h.queries != nil {
355: 		if study, err := h.queries.Study(r.Context(), snapshot.Target.Study); err == nil {
356: 			insights = newRunStudyInsightsView(snapshot.Target.Study, study)
357: 		}
358: 	}
359: 	var sprintUsage *runSprintUsageView
360: 	if snapshot.Target.Sprint != "" && snapshot.Target.Project != "" && h.queries != nil {
361: 		if usageQueries, ok := h.queries.(app.WebSprintUsageQueries); ok {
362: 			if metrics, err := usageQueries.SprintRuntimeUsage(r.Context(), snapshot.Target.Project, snapshot.Target.Sprint); err == nil {
363: 				summary := newRunSprintUsageView(snapshot.Target.Sprint, metrics)
364: 				sprintUsage = &summary
365: 			}
366: 		}
367: 	}
368: 	var qaInsights *runQAInsightsView
369: 	if isQARunTarget(snapshot.Target) {
370: 		qaInsights = h.newRunQAInsightsView(r, snapshot)
371: 	}
372: 	eventViews := make([]runEventView, 0, len(events))
373: 	for _, event := range events {
374: 		eventViews = append(eventViews, newRunEventView(event))
375: 	}
376: 	h.render(w, r, http.StatusOK, "run", pageModel{Title: "Run " + value, Heading: "Run detail", Run: &detail, StudyInsights: insights, SprintUsage: sprintUsage, QAInsights: qaInsights, RunEvents: eventViews, NextEventsURL: nextEventsURL, Page: "run", SurfaceContract: runSurfaceContract})
377: }

383: func (h *handler) newRunQAInsightsView(r *http.Request, snapshot app.RunSnapshot) *runQAInsightsView {
384: 	view := &runQAInsightsView{Project: snapshot.Target.Project, Sprint: snapshot.Target.Sprint}
385: 	view.StatusURL = "/api/v1/projects/" + url.PathEscape(view.Project) + "/sprints/" + url.PathEscape(view.Sprint) + "/qa"
386: 	view.SynthesisURL = view.StatusURL + "/synthesis"
387: 	if h.qa == nil {
388: 		view.Unavailable = "The canonical QA reader is unavailable. The durable event journal remains authoritative for this run."
389: 		return view
390: 	}
391: 	qa, err := h.qa.QAStatus(r.Context(), app.QARequest{Project: view.Project, Sprint: view.Sprint})
392: 	if err != nil {
393: 		view.Unavailable = "The canonical QA snapshot could not be read. The durable event journal remains available below."
394: 		return view
395: 	}
396: 	view.QA = qa
397: 	view.ProgressMax = qa.TotalShards
398: 	if view.ProgressMax < 1 {
399: 		view.ProgressMax = 1
400: 	}
401: 	if qa.RunID != "" && qa.RunID != string(snapshot.RunID) {
402: 		view.Historical = true
403: 		view.CurrentRunID = qa.RunID
404: 		return view
405: 	}
406: 	if qa.TotalShards > 0 {
407: 		view.CompletionPercent = qa.CompletedShards * 100 / qa.TotalShards
408: 	}
409: 	keys := make([]string, 0, len(qa.OutcomeTotals))
410: 	for key := range qa.OutcomeTotals {
411: 		keys = append(keys, key)
412: 	}
413: 	sort.Strings(keys)
414: 	for _, key := range keys {
415: 		view.Outcomes = append(view.Outcomes, runQACountView{Label: key, Value: qa.OutcomeTotals[key]})
416: 	}
417: 	for _, shard := range qa.Shards {
418: 		view.ApprovedChecks += len(shard.ApprovedChecks)
419: 		view.Attempts += len(shard.Attempts)
420: 		view.Theories += len(shard.Theories)
421: 		for _, attempt := range shard.Attempts {
422: 			view.Commands += len(attempt.Commands)
423: 			view.ContextRequests += len(attempt.ContextRequests)
424: 			view.Evidence += len(attempt.Evidence)
425: 		}
426: 		for _, theory := range shard.Theories {
427: 			view.Evidence += len(theory.Evidence)
428: 		}
429: 	}
430: 	synthesis, err := h.qa.QASynthesis(r.Context(), app.QARequest{Project: view.Project, Sprint: view.Sprint})
431: 	if err != nil {
432: 		view.SynthesisUnavailable = "The retained synthesis could not be read."
433: 		return view
434: 	}
435: 	view.Synthesis = synthesis
436: 	view.HasSynthesis = synthesis.ID != ""
437: 	return view
438: }

576: func newSprintStageUsageView(slug string, metrics app.SprintMetricsSummary) sprintStageUsageView {
577: 	view := sprintStageUsageView{runUsageView: runUsageView{Scope: slug, cacheHitComplete: true}, UpdatedAt: metrics.UpdatedAt}
578: 	type stageAgg struct {
579: 		runs             int
580: 		tokens           int64
581: 		tokensKnown      bool
582: 		cacheRead        int64
583: 		cacheReadKnown   bool
584: 		cacheWrite       int64
585: 		cacheWriteKnown  bool
586: 		cost             float64
587: 		costKnown        bool
588: 		providerReported int
589: 		modelPriced      int
590: 	}
591: 	agg := map[string]*stageAgg{}
592: 	for _, run := range metrics.RecentRuns {
593: 		view.addTokens(run.InputKnown, run.Input, run.OutputKnown, run.Output, run.ReasoningKnown, run.Reasoning,
594: 			run.CacheReadKnown, run.CacheRead, run.CacheWriteKnown, run.CacheWrite, run.TotalKnown, run.Total)
595: 		view.addCost(run.CostKnown, run.CostAmount, run.CostSource)
596: 		a, ok := agg[run.Stage]
597: 		if !ok {
598: 			a = &stageAgg{}
599: 			agg[run.Stage] = a
600: 		}
601: 		a.runs++
602: 		if run.TotalKnown {
603: 			a.tokens += run.Total
604: 			a.tokensKnown = true
605: 		}
606: 		if run.CacheReadKnown {
607: 			a.cacheRead += run.CacheRead
608: 			a.cacheReadKnown = true
609: 		}
610: 		if run.CacheWriteKnown {
611: 			a.cacheWrite += run.CacheWrite
612: 			a.cacheWriteKnown = true
613: 		}
614: 		if run.CostKnown {
615: 			a.cost += run.CostAmount
616: 			a.costKnown = true
617: 			switch run.CostSource {
618: 			case "model_priced":
619: 				a.modelPriced++
620: 			case "provider_reported":
621: 				a.providerReported++
622: 			}
623: 		}
624: 	}
625: 	seen := map[string]bool{}
626: 	emit := func(name string) {
627: 		if seen[name] {
628: 			return
629: 		}
630: 		seen[name] = true
631: 		a, ok := agg[name]
632: 		if !ok {
633: 			return
634: 		}
635: 		tokens := "-"
636: 		if a.tokensKnown {
637: 			tokens = strconv.FormatInt(a.tokens, 10)
638: 		}
639: 		cacheR := "-"
640: 		if a.cacheReadKnown {
641: 			cacheR = strconv.FormatInt(a.cacheRead, 10)
642: 		}
643: 		cacheW := "-"
644: 		if a.cacheWriteKnown {
645: 			cacheW = strconv.FormatInt(a.cacheWrite, 10)
646: 		}
647: 		cost := "-"
648: 		costNote := ""
649: 		if a.costKnown {
650: 			suffix := ""
651: 			if a.modelPriced > 0 {
652: 				suffix = "*"
653: 			}
654: 			cost = formatRunUSD(a.cost) + suffix
655: 			if a.modelPriced > 0 && a.providerReported > 0 {
656: 				costNote = "mixed"
657: 			} else if a.modelPriced > 0 {
658: 				costNote = "rate-table estimate"
659: 			} else if a.providerReported > 0 {
660: 				costNote = "provider reported"
661: 			}
662: 		}
663: 		view.Rows = append(view.Rows, sprintStageUsageRow{Stage: name, Runs: a.runs, Tokens: tokens, CacheR: cacheR, CacheW: cacheW, Cost: cost, CostNote: costNote})
664: 	}
665: 	for _, name := range sprintStageOrder() {
666: 		emit(name)
667: 	}
668: 	for name := range agg {
669: 		emit(name)
670: 	}
671: 	finalizeRunUsageView(&view.runUsageView)
672: 	view.HasMetrics = len(metrics.RecentRuns) > 0
673: 	return view
674: }

691: func newRunDetailView(snapshot app.RunSnapshot) runDetailView {
692: 	history := string(snapshot.RecordState)
693: 	if !snapshot.HistoryComplete {
694: 		history += " · incomplete before sequence " + strconv.FormatUint(snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence, 10)
695: 	}
696: 	terminal := ""
697: 	terminalOutcome := ""
698: 	terminalReason := ""
699: 	if snapshot.Terminal != nil {
700: 		terminalOutcome = string(snapshot.Terminal.Outcome)
701: 		terminalReason = snapshot.Terminal.Reason
702: 		terminal = terminalOutcome
703: 		if terminalReason != "" {
704: 			terminal += " · " + terminalReason
705: 		}
706: 	}
707: 	started := snapshot.AcceptedAt
708: 	if snapshot.StartedAt != nil {
709: 		started = *snapshot.StartedAt
710: 	}

376: func (h *operationHub) subscribe(session, id string, lastID uint64) ([]operationEvent, <-chan operationEvent, func(), error) {
377: 	h.mu.Lock()
378: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
379: 	h.reapLocked()

381: 	if record == nil || record.session != session {
382: 		return nil, nil, nil, errOperationNotFound

384: 	if h.streams >= MaxConcurrentStreams || len(record.subscribers) >= MaxSubscribersPerOperation {

388: 	if lastID > 0 && len(record.events) > 0 && lastID < record.events[0].ID-1 {
389: 		h.counters.replayGaps.Add(1)
390: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "recovery_required", map[string]any{
391: 			"oldest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.events[0].ID, 10),
392: 			"newest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.nextEventID, 10),
393: 			"refresh_path":       record.doc.DurableStatus.RefreshPath,
394: 		})

398: 	for _, event := range record.events {

409: 		h.streams++
410: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(1)
411: 	}

413: 	unsubscribe := func() {
414: 		once.Do(func() {
415: 			h.mu.Lock()
416: 			defer h.mu.Unlock()
417: 			if current, ok := record.subscribers[sub.id]; ok {
418: 				delete(record.subscribers, sub.id)
419: 				h.streams--
420: 				h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
421: 				close(current.ch)
422: 			}
423: 		})
424: 	}

428: func (h *operationHub) appendEventLocked(record *operationRecord, name string, payload any) {
429: 	name = stableOperationEventName(name)
430: 	record.nextEventID++
431: 	body := map[string]any{
432: 		"operation_id": record.doc.ID,
433: 		"time":         h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
434: 		"sequence":     record.nextEventID,
435: 		"payload":      payload,
436: 	}
437: 	data, err := json.Marshal(body)
438: 	if err != nil {
439: 		h.counters.projectionDrops.Add(1)
440: 		return
441: 	}
442: 	if len(data) > MaxEncodedEventBytes {
443: 		data, _ = json.Marshal(map[string]any{
444: 			"operation_id": record.doc.ID, "time": h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
445: 			"sequence": record.nextEventID, "payload": map[string]any{"message": "event projection exceeded the safe size limit"},
446: 		})
447: 		name = "warning"
448: 	}
449: 	event := operationEvent{ID: record.nextEventID, Name: name, Data: data}
450: 	record.events = append(record.events, event)
451: 	record.eventBytes += len(data)
452: 	for len(record.events) > MaxEventsPerOperation || record.eventBytes > MaxEventBytesPerOperation {
453: 		record.eventBytes -= len(record.events[0].Data)
454: 		record.events = record.events[1:]
455: 	}
456: 	record.doc.LastEventID = strconv.FormatUint(event.ID, 10)

459: 		case subscriber.ch <- event:

461: 			close(subscriber.ch)
462: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)
463: 			h.streams--
464: 			h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
465: 			h.counters.slowSubscribers.Add(1)
466: 		}
467: 	}
468: }

470: func stableOperationEventName(name string) string {
471: 	switch name {
472: 	case "snapshot", "progress", "warning", "finding", "artifact", "cancel_requested", "recovery_required", "terminal":
473: 		return name
474: 	default:
475: 		return "progress"

479: func (h *operationHub) drainAndWait(ctx context.Context) error {
480: 	h.mu.Lock()
481: 	h.draining = true
482: 	var records []*operationRecord
483: 	for _, record := range h.records {
484: 		if !terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
485: 			records = append(records, record)
486: 		}
487: 	}
488: 	h.mu.Unlock()
489: 	for _, record := range records {
490: 		_, _, _ = h.cancelOperation("", record.doc.ID, "server_shutdown")
491: 	}
492: 	h.counters.shutdownCleanups.Add(int64(len(records)))
493: 	for _, record := range records {
494: 		select {
495: 		case <-record.done:
496: 		case <-ctx.Done():
497: 			persistErr := h.persistCleanupUncertain(records)
498: 			h.markCleanupUncertain(records)
499: 			return errors.Join(ctx.Err(), persistErr)
500: 		}
501: 	}
502: 	return nil

505: func (h *operationHub) persistCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) error {
506: 	recorder, ok := h.ops.(app.OperationCleanupRecorder)
507: 	if !ok {
508: 		return errors.New("operation capability cannot persist cleanup uncertainty")
509: 	}
510: 	var result error
511: 	for _, record := range records {
512: 		h.mu.Lock()
513: 		terminal := terminalOperationState(record.doc.State)
514: 		h.mu.Unlock()
515: 		if terminal {
516: 			continue
517: 		}
518: 		persistCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
519: 		err := recorder.RecordOperationCleanupUncertain(persistCtx, app.OperationCleanupUncertain{
520: 			OperationID: record.doc.ID,
521: 			Request:     record.request,
522: 			Reason:      "server_shutdown",
523: 			RecordedAt:  h.now().UTC(),
524: 		})
525: 		cancel()
526: 		if err != nil {
527: 			result = errors.Join(result, fmt.Errorf("persist cleanup uncertainty for %s: %w", record.doc.ID, err))

529: 	}
530: 	return result

533: func (h *operationHub) markCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) {

535: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()

537: 	for _, record := range records {
538: 		if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
539: 			continue
540: 		}

542: 		record.doc.Reason = "server_shutdown"
543: 		record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
544: 		record.doc.Result = &operationResultDTO{State: "cleanup_uncertain", Message: "Cleanup did not finish before the shutdown deadline. Refresh durable status before retrying."}

548: 		h.counters.terminal.Add(1)
549: 		close(record.done)
550: 		for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
551: 			close(subscriber.ch)
552: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)
553: 			h.streams--
554: 			h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
555: 		}
556: 	}

561: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()

565: func (h *operationHub) reapLocked() {
566: 	now := h.now().UTC()

577: func projectOperationResult(result app.OperationResult) *operationResultDTO {
578: 	out := &operationResultDTO{
579: 		State: safeWebText(string(result.State)), Subject: safeWebText(result.Subject), Message: safeWebText(result.Message),
580: 		Content: safeProjectedText(result.Content, MaxTerminalResultBytes/2), Truncated: result.Truncated,
581: 	}
582: 	for _, finding := range result.Findings {
583: 		out.Findings = append(out.Findings, findingDTO{
584: 			Severity: safeWebText(finding.Severity), Section: safeWebText(finding.Section), Problem: safeWebText(finding.Problem),
585: 			Cause: safeWebText(finding.Cause), Suggestion: safeWebText(finding.Suggestion),
586: 		})
587: 	}
588: 	if result.Error != nil {
589: 		out.Error = &errorBody{Code: safeWebText(result.Error.Code), Message: safeWebText(result.Error.Message), Retryable: result.Error.Retryable, Details: map[string]any{
590: 			"category": safeWebText(result.Error.Category), "component": safeWebText(result.Error.Component), "cause": safeWebText(result.Error.Cause), "guidance": safeWebText(result.Error.Guidance),
591: 		}}
592: 	}
593: 	if data, _ := json.Marshal(out); len(data) > MaxTerminalResultBytes {
594: 		out.Content = ""
595: 		out.Findings = nil
596: 		out.Truncated = true
597: 		out.Message = safeBoundedText(out.Message, 4096)

607: 		if doc.Result.Error != nil {
608: 			err := *doc.Result.Error
609: 			result.Error = &err
610: 		}
611: 		clone.Result = &result
612: 	}

151: 	h.mu.Lock()
152: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
153: 	h.reapLocked()
154: 	if id := h.dedup[dedupKey]; dedupKey != "" && id != "" {
155: 		if record := h.records[id]; record != nil && record.session == session {
156: 			return cloneOperationDocument(record.doc), nil
157: 		}
158: 		delete(h.dedup, dedupKey)
159: 	}
160: 	if h.draining {
161: 		h.counters.capacityRejections.Add(1)
162: 		return operationDocument{}, errServerDraining
163: 	}
164: 	if h.active >= MaxActiveOperations {
165: 		h.counters.capacityRejections.Add(1)
166: 		return operationDocument{}, errOperationCapacity
167: 	}
168: 	if h.ops == nil {
169: 		return operationDocument{}, errors.New("operation capability unavailable")
170: 	}
171: 	prepared, err := confirm()
172: 	if err != nil {
173: 		return operationDocument{}, err
174: 	}
175: 	id := "op_" + h.id()
176: 	for h.records[id] != nil {
177: 		id = "op_" + h.id()
178: 	}
179: 	created := h.now().UTC()
180: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(h.rootCtx)
181: 	if manager, ok := h.ops.(app.DurableOperationManager); ok {
182: 		accepted, acceptErr := manager.AcceptOperation(ctx, prepared, dedupKey)
183: 		if acceptErr != nil {
184: 			if !errors.Is(acceptErr, app.ErrWebUnavailable) {
185: 				cancel()
186: 				return operationDocument{}, acceptErr
187: 			}
188: 		} else {
189: 			id = accepted.RunID
190: 			if accepted.Context != nil {
191: 				ctx = accepted.Context
192: 			}
193: 			if accepted.Existing {
194: 				doc := operationDocument{ID: id, Kind: prepared.Request.Kind, State: accepted.Lifecycle, CreatedAt: created, DurableStatus: durableStatusDTO{Available: true, RefreshPath: "/runs/" + id}}
195: 				cancel()
196: 				return doc, nil
197: 			}
198: 		}
199: 	}
200: 	record := &operationRecord{
201: 		doc: operationDocument{
202: 			ID: id, Kind: prepared.Request.Kind, State: "accepted", CreatedAt: created,
203: 			DurableStatus: durableStatusDTO{Available: prepared.DurableRefreshPath != "", RefreshPath: prepared.DurableRefreshPath},
204: 		},
205: 		session: session, request: prepared.Request, cancel: cancel, done: make(chan struct{}),
206: 		subscribers: make(map[uint64]*operationSubscriber), dedupKey: dedupKey,
207: 	}
208: 	h.records[id] = record
209: 	if dedupKey != "" {
210: 		h.dedup[dedupKey] = id
211: 	}
212: 	h.active++
213: 	h.counters.starts.Add(1)
214: 	h.counters.active.Add(1)
215: 	h.appendEventLocked(record, "snapshot", map[string]any{"state": "accepted"})
216: 	doc := cloneOperationDocument(record.doc)
217: 	go h.run(ctx, record)
218: 	return doc, nil
219: }

222: 	started := h.now().UTC()
223: 	h.mu.Lock()
224: 	if record.doc.State == "accepted" {
225: 		record.doc.State = "running"

227: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "progress", map[string]any{"message": "operation started", "state": "running"})

229: 	h.mu.Unlock()

232: 		h.publishAppEvent(record, event)
233: 	})
234: 	if manager, ok := h.ops.(app.DurableOperationManager); ok {
235: 		finishCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
236: 		finishErr := manager.FinishOperation(finishCtx, record.doc.ID, result.State, runErr)
237: 		cancel()
238: 		if finishErr != nil && !errors.Is(finishErr, app.ErrWebUnavailable) {
239: 			runErr = errors.Join(runErr, finishErr)

241: 	}

249: 			record.cancel()

251: 		}
252: 		if err == nil && !committed {
253: 			return

255: 	}
256: 	name := "progress"
257: 	if event.State == app.OperationFailed {
258: 		name = "warning"
259: 	}
260: 	payload := map[string]any{

262: 		"message": safeWebText(event.Message), "completed": event.Completed, "total": event.Total, "attempt": event.Attempt,
263: 		"event_kind": safeWebText(event.EventKind), "event_type": safeWebText(event.EventType), "tool": safeWebText(event.Tool), "action": safeWebText(event.Action),
264: 		"tool_call_id": safeWebText(event.ToolCallID), "tool_status": safeWebText(event.ToolStatus),
265: 		"tool_arguments": event.ToolArguments, "tool_result": event.ToolResult, "tool_error": event.ToolError,
266: 		"reason": safeWebText(event.Reason), "detail": safeWebText(event.Detail),
267: 		"runtime_attempts": event.RuntimeAttempts, "turns": event.Turns, "turns_known": event.TurnsKnown,
268: 		"tokens": event.Tokens, "tokens_known": event.TokensKnown, "duration": safeWebText(event.Duration),
269: 		"provider": safeWebText(event.Provider), "model": safeWebText(event.Model), "harness": safeWebText(event.Harness), "cost": safeWebText(event.Cost), "runtime_events": event.RuntimeEvents,
270: 	}

272: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()

279: func (h *operationHub) finish(record *operationRecord, result app.OperationResult, runErr error) {
280: 	finished := h.now().UTC()
281: 	h.mu.Lock()
282: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
283: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
284: 		return
285: 	}
286: 	state := "succeeded"
287: 	switch {
288: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), result.State == app.OperationCancelled:
289: 		state = "cancelled"
290: 	case runErr != nil, result.State == app.OperationFailed:
291: 		state = "failed"
292: 	case result.State == app.OperationPartial:
293: 		state = "interrupted"
294: 	}
295: 	record.doc.State = state
296: 	record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
297: 	record.doc.Result = projectOperationResult(result)
298: 	h.appendEventLocked(record, "terminal", map[string]any{"state": state, "reason": record.doc.Reason, "result": record.doc.Result})
299: 	h.active--
300: 	h.counters.active.Add(-1)
301: 	h.counters.terminal.Add(1)
302: 	close(record.done)
303: 	for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
304: 		close(subscriber.ch)
305: 		delete(record.subscribers, id)
306: 		h.streams--
307: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
308: 	}
309: }

376: func (h *operationHub) subscribe(session, id string, lastID uint64) ([]operationEvent, <-chan operationEvent, func(), error) {
377: 	h.mu.Lock()
378: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
379: 	h.reapLocked()
380: 	record := h.records[id]
381: 	if record == nil || record.session != session {
382: 		return nil, nil, nil, errOperationNotFound
383: 	}
384: 	if h.streams >= MaxConcurrentStreams || len(record.subscribers) >= MaxSubscribersPerOperation {
385: 		h.counters.capacityRejections.Add(1)

388: 	if lastID > 0 && len(record.events) > 0 && lastID < record.events[0].ID-1 {
389: 		h.counters.replayGaps.Add(1)
390: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "recovery_required", map[string]any{
391: 			"oldest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.events[0].ID, 10),
392: 			"newest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.nextEventID, 10),
393: 			"refresh_path":       record.doc.DurableStatus.RefreshPath,
394: 		})
395: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "snapshot", map[string]any{"state": record.doc.State, "reason": record.doc.Reason})
396: 	}

398: 	for _, event := range record.events {
399: 		if event.ID > lastID {
400: 			replay = append(replay, event)
401: 		}
402: 	}
403: 	record.nextSubID++

405: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
406: 		close(sub.ch)
407: 	} else {
408: 		record.subscribers[sub.id] = sub
409: 		h.streams++
410: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(1)
411: 	}
412: 	var once sync.Once
413: 	unsubscribe := func() {
414: 		once.Do(func() {
415: 			h.mu.Lock()
416: 			defer h.mu.Unlock()
417: 			if current, ok := record.subscribers[sub.id]; ok {
418: 				delete(record.subscribers, sub.id)
419: 				h.streams--
420: 				h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
421: 				close(current.ch)
422: 			}
423: 		})
424: 	}

428: func (h *operationHub) appendEventLocked(record *operationRecord, name string, payload any) {
429: 	name = stableOperationEventName(name)

431: 	body := map[string]any{

435: 		"payload":      payload,
436: 	}

445: 			"sequence": record.nextEventID, "payload": map[string]any{"message": "event projection exceeded the safe size limit"},

451: 	record.eventBytes += len(data)

479: func (h *operationHub) drainAndWait(ctx context.Context) error {
480: 	h.mu.Lock()
481: 	h.draining = true
482: 	var records []*operationRecord
483: 	for _, record := range h.records {
484: 		if !terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
485: 			records = append(records, record)
486: 		}
487: 	}
488: 	h.mu.Unlock()
489: 	for _, record := range records {
490: 		_, _, _ = h.cancelOperation("", record.doc.ID, "server_shutdown")
491: 	}
492: 	h.counters.shutdownCleanups.Add(int64(len(records)))
493: 	for _, record := range records {
494: 		select {
495: 		case <-record.done:
496: 		case <-ctx.Done():
497: 			persistErr := h.persistCleanupUncertain(records)
498: 			h.markCleanupUncertain(records)
499: 			return errors.Join(ctx.Err(), persistErr)

505: func (h *operationHub) persistCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) error {
506: 	recorder, ok := h.ops.(app.OperationCleanupRecorder)
507: 	if !ok {
508: 		return errors.New("operation capability cannot persist cleanup uncertainty")
509: 	}
510: 	var result error
511: 	for _, record := range records {
512: 		h.mu.Lock()
513: 		terminal := terminalOperationState(record.doc.State)
514: 		h.mu.Unlock()
515: 		if terminal {
516: 			continue
517: 		}
518: 		persistCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
519: 		err := recorder.RecordOperationCleanupUncertain(persistCtx, app.OperationCleanupUncertain{
520: 			OperationID: record.doc.ID,
521: 			Request:     record.request,
522: 			Reason:      "server_shutdown",
523: 			RecordedAt:  h.now().UTC(),
524: 		})
525: 		cancel()
526: 		if err != nil {
527: 			result = errors.Join(result, fmt.Errorf("persist cleanup uncertainty for %s: %w", record.doc.ID, err))
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	return result

536: 	finished := h.now().UTC()
537: 	for _, record := range records {
538: 		if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
